cases.prompt: /vibe로 앱 기능을 구현해줘. 필요하면 /skstack 절차를 사용해.

assertions.text: Runs skstack as a procedure under the existing /vibe run, without creating a second coordinator, budget or model/Bot route.
Produces a scoped build plan, checkpoints and verification appropriate to the task.
Offers only a limited manual plan and does not launch an independent autonomous orchestration run.
